card.name: Food prices and partway through words
card.fires_on: Mainly the word price(s) after food or grain in news about commodities. Also fires inside a year or code number and partway through words like Influenza and Deepwater.

modes.label: Commodity prices
modes.description: The word price or prices right after food or grain in economic news.
modes.example: due to high food<< prices>> and food shortages.

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a year or a patent or ID number.

modes.label: Inside names
modes.description: Partway through a longer word or name such as Influenza or Deepwater.
modes.example: Infl<<uen>>za usually ramps up in February
